title: Async legacy writes are cancelled as soon as the HTTP handler returns
description: Goroutines derive timeout from inbound request context which is cancelled on handler return, causing legacy writes to abort with context.Canceled and creating divergence between unified and legacy storage

title: Panics in detached goroutines kill the Grafana process
description: Bare goroutines lack recover() on stack; panics in legacy store calls terminate the entire Grafana process instead of being handled by apiserver's panic filter

title: Storage/legacy duration metrics are recorded against the wrong series
description: Metrics recording inverts error flags: storage failures record as legacy errors and legacy delete-collection records as storage duration, making metrics unusable for gating mode-3 rollout

title: Delete's success path writes the object name into the 'kind' metric label
description: Per-object name passed to metric instead of options.Kind, causing unbounded cardinality growth and unaggregatable series

title: The new mode-3 integration tests actually run in mode 1
description: Mode transition logic lacks Mode2→Mode3 gate; all three new subtests exercise mode 1, leaving mode-3 code without integration coverage

title: Delete puts the wrong logger into the context
description: Uses bare receiver logger instead of enriched log variable, causing downstream and legacy store logging to lack name, kind, and method fields
